title: Stairway To Heaven Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Stairway To Heaven is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to Stairway to Heaven | A Seaside IconWelcome to Stairway to Heaven, a modern architectural gem nestled in the heart of Ruskin Park in Seaside, Florida—and famously featured in the 1996 film The Truman Show. Designed by renowned New York architect Alexander Gorlin, this historic townhome blends bold modernism with classic Seaside charm, offering a truly unforgettable coastal getaway.Surrounded by shaded green space and just steps from Seaside’s town center, this unique residence comfortably sleeps up to six guests and features one of the most spectacular rooftop terraces in Seaside, complete with sweeping views of the Gulf and town below.First Floor | Casual Comfort & Flexible LivingThe first floor welcomes guests with a cozy secondary living area, ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach. This space includes a large flat-screen TV, a game table for four, a mini refrigerator, and a washer and dryer, making it perfect for movie nights or casual entertaining. Two futon sleeper sofas provide additional sleeping accommodations.Adjacent to the living space is a thoughtfully designed queen bedroom featuring modern furnishings, a flat-screen TV, and convenient access to a full bathroom, offering comfort and privacy for guests.Second Floor | Open Living & Chef’s KitchenThe second level showcases the home’s main living space with an open-concept layout filled with natural light. The fully equipped kitchen features marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, bar-top seating, and a dining table for four—perfect for shared meals and easy entertaining. A nearby half bath adds convenience to this level.Primary Suite | Elevated Luxury & Natural LightA striking oak and plaster spiral staircase leads to the private king bedroom suite, where architectural detail and comfort converge. This serene retreat includes marble countertops and a spa-like bathroom with a luxurious shower illuminated by a skylight overhead. Step out onto the private balcony to enjoy peaceful views of Seaside’s charming surroundings.Rooftop Terrace | The Iconic Stairway to HeavenFrom the king suite, ascend to the crown jewel of the home—an expansive open-air rooftop deck known as the iconic Stairway to Heaven. This stunning terrace features comfortable lounge seating and delivers panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico and the vibrant town of Seaside, making it the ultimate spot for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, or stargazing under the Florida sky.A One-of-a-Kind Seaside ExperienceWith its historic significance, architectural pedigree, and unbeatable location in Ruskin Park, Stairway to Heaven offers a rare opportunity to experience Seaside, Florida from a truly elevated perspective. Whether you’re drawn by its cinematic history, rooftop views, or central walkability, this townhome promises a stay unlike any other.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES1,892 square feetSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion4-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessPrivate driveway with parking for two carsSonos sound system in the living room and primary bedroomThis home streams live TV through YouTubeTV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsDedicated work-from-home desk conveniently located off the kitchenAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR24-000494
